subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

(14, 40, 83)
solution:
The logic follows here is;

***(First Number × 3) - 2 = Second Number***

***(Second Number × 2) + 3 = Third Number***

In (14, 40, 83);

(14 × 3) - 2

42 - 2 = 40

(40 × 2) + 3 

= 80 + 3 = 83

Similarly;

In (13, 37, 77);

(13 × 3) - 2

= 39 - 2 = 37

(37 × 2) + 3

= 74 + 3 = 77

Hence, **"(13, 37, 77)"** is the correct answer.
